jobs.title: Assistant
jobs.organization: Ministry of National Health Services Regulations and Coordination
jobs.description:
Graduate with 6 Weeks Basic IT Training Course (Including MS Office conducted by NITB)
All Appointments shall be made in accordance with Establishment Division Recruitment Policy
Applicants all ready in Govt Service may apply through proper channel and would be required to produce NOC at time of interview
Those who fulfill the requisite qualification mentioned against post may apply online on National Job Portal available on (njp.gov.pk) within 15 days of publishing of this advertisement
Candidates / applicants may also visit www.nhsrc.gov.pk
relevant / required documents ( in original) should be submitted at time of Test / interview
Age Relaxation As per rules of Federal Government
No TA/DA will be admissible to appear for Test / Interview
No application will be recieved by hand

jobs.title: Sweeper - BS-01
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Primary.
No experience requirement specified.
Clean offices, corridors, washrooms and assigned premises.
Collect and dispose of waste in designated areas.
Maintain hygiene and sanitation standards.
Clean furniture, fixtures and other assigned areas.
Report sanitation or maintenance issues to the supervisor.
Perform other cleaning-related duties assigned by the administration.
Age limit: 18–30 years. Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan (Merit).

jobs.title: Chowkidar - BS-01
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Primary.
No experience requirement specified.
Guard and monitor assigned government premises.
Maintain vigilance over entry and exit points.
Report suspicious activities or security incidents.
Conduct routine checks of assigned premises.
Assist in safeguarding government property and equipment.
Perform other security-related duties assigned by the administration.
Age limit: 18–30 years. Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan (Merit).

jobs.title: Farash - BS-01
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Primary.
No experience requirement specified.
Arrange and maintain office furniture, carpets and floor coverings.
Assist in setting up meeting rooms and official functions.
Support cleaning and general upkeep of assigned premises.
Move and arrange office equipment and materials as required.
Perform other duties assigned by the administration.
Age limit: 18–30 years. Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan.
Quota: Merit 4 posts, Women 1 post.

jobs.title: Naib Qasid -BS-01
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Primary.
No experience requirement specified.
Assist officers and staff in routine office activities.
Carry files, documents and official correspondence between sections.
Maintain cleanliness and general arrangement of office rooms.
Assist in serving water and refreshments during official meetings.
Support movement and arrangement of office materials.
Perform other duties assigned by the supervisory officer.
Age limit: 18–30 years. Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan.
Quota: Merit 49 posts, Women 6 posts, Minorities 3 posts.

jobs.title: Duplicating Machine Operator - BS-04
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Primary.
Knowledge of operating a duplicating machine is essential.
No minimum years of experience specified.
Operate duplicating and document reproduction machines.
Prepare photocopies and duplicate official documents.
Maintain the cleanliness and basic working condition of equipment.
Arrange and organize reproduced documents.
Monitor paper and consumable supplies.
Perform other related duties assigned by the supervisor.
Age limit: 18–30 years. Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan (Merit).

jobs.title: Dispatch Rider - BS-04
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Primary.
Must possess a valid driving licence.
Must be well versed in traffic rules.
No minimum years of experience specified.
Deliver official letters, documents and correspondence.
Collect and dispatch official mail between departments and offices.
Maintain delivery records and acknowledgment receipts.
Ensure timely and secure delivery of confidential documents.
Maintain the assigned motorcycle or vehicle in operational condition.
Perform other dispatch-related duties assigned by the office.
Age limit: 18–30 years. Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan (Merit).

jobs.title: Staff Car Driver - BS-04
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Primary.
Must possess a valid LTV driving licence.
Must be well versed in traffic rules.
No minimum years of driving experience specified.
Drive official vehicles for authorized government duties.
Ensure safe transportation of officers and authorized personnel.
Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of assigned vehicles.
Maintain vehicle logbooks and mileage records
Report mechanical faults and maintenance requirements.
Comply with traffic laws and departmental instructions.
Age limit: 18–30 years.Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan (Merit).

jobs.title: Lower Division Clerk - BS-11
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Matriculation.
Minimum typing speed of 30 words per minute.
No minimum years of experience specified.
Maintain office files, registers and official records.
Prepare and type official letters and documents.
Perform data entry and routine clerical work.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence.
Assist in filing, recordkeeping and documentation.
Perform other duties assigned by the supervisory officer.
Age limit: 18–30 years.Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan (Merit).

jobs.title: Stenotypist BS-14
jobs.organization: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
jobs.description:
Education: Intermediate.
Minimum shorthand speed of 80 words per minute.
Minimum typing speed of 40 words per minute.
Must be computer literate.
No minimum years of experience specified.
Take dictation and transcribe official correspondence.
Prepare letters, reports, meeting minutes and official documents.
Maintain confidential records and correspondence.
Perform typing, formatting and data-entry assignments.
Provide secretarial and administrative support to officers.
Perform other official duties assigned by the competent authority.
Age limit: 18–30 years. Age relaxation shall be admissible as per applicable Government rules.
Domicile: Balochistan (Merit).
